newsitem.title: USA: Gadzooks sees 55-60 new stores in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Gadzooks sees 55-60 new stores in 1997.

text.p: Gadzooks Inc chairman and chief executive Jerry Szczepanski said on Tuesday the company expects to open 55 to 60 stores in 1997, a growth rate of around 30 percent in the teen clothing and accessory seller's outlets.

Szczepanski told investors at a Montgomery Securities conference here that the company, which ended 1995 with 126 stores and is adding 57 this year, expects it can add a total of about 150 to 200 stores in the 24-state region it serves.
Nationwide, he said, eventual expansion could result in a network of some 700 to 800 stores across the country.
Monty Standifer, senior vice president and chief financial officer, told investors "we think our margins for the last half of this year will be somewhat comparable to a year ago."

Year-ago second half margin figures for the company were not immediately available. As a percentage of sales, operating income was 8.0 percent in the fiscal year to January 31, 1996, up from 6.0 percent in the previous fiscal year.
